newsitem.title: CANADA: T-D Bank closes Waterhouse merger.
newsitem.headline: T-D Bank closes Waterhouse merger.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Tuesday that it has closed its C$715 million takeover of U.S. discount brokerage firm Waterhouse Investor Services Inc.
T-D Bank's Green Line Investor Services, Canada's dominant discount broker, will join forces with Waterhouse to form the world's third-largest discount brokerage.
"We will be able to deliver a broad range of integrated investment services to our customers in Canada and the United States." Green Line chairman Keith Gray said in a statement.
Together, Green Line and Waterhouse have over one million customers.
Waterhouse said the merger will help the company meet its goal of growing to 200 branches by the year 2000, up from its current 90 branches.
Waterhouse shareholders received a equivalent of US$38 per share in cash and T-D Bank common stock.
TD Bank said it expects to issue approximately 16.7 million common shares as part of the merger transaction.
The bank said it has already repurchased about 16.1 million of its common shares under a previously announced share buyback program.
